item.title: Clemson's planning commission votes in favor of neighborhood protection plan

item.title: Spartanburg police report lowest crime levels in 29 years
item.description: The Spartanburg Police Department (SPD) said crime across the city continued to decline in 2025, reaching the lowest levels the department has seen in nearly three decades.
